blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In-context learning (ICL) enables large vision-language models (LVLMs) to perform tasks by following patterns from in-context examples, yet its potential to amplify societal biases remains underexplored. We systematically investigate how ICL influences gender bias in LVLMs through VL-BICLE, an evaluation framework comprising six ICL settings, three tasks, and four datasets. Our experiments on six LVLMs reveal that gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force, shifting model bias toward the demonstrated gender through a cross-gender mechanism that disproportionately degrades performance on the opposite gender. This effect appears in image captioning and pronoun prediction but not in visual question answering, indicating that gendered ICL influences bias only when the task output involves gendered language. Similarity-based retrieval methods inherit the training pool’s gender imbalance and offer no debiasing advantage, while standard quality metrics remain blind to these bias shifts. To mitigate this bias, we replace real in-context images with synthetic ones from stable diffusion models while keeping captions unchanged. This simple intervention reduces gender bias without degrading caption quality. The code can be found at: https://github.com/mathfather/Gender-Bias-in-VL-ICL .
blocks.zh: 内文学习(ICL)使大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)能够按照内文实例的模式完成任务,但其扩大社会偏见的潜力仍然没有得到充分发挥。 我们通过VL-BICLE系统调查ICL如何影响LVLMs中的性别偏见,这个评价框架包括六个ICL设置,三个任务,四个数据集. 我们对6个LVLM的实验表明,性别化的ICL演示是一种方向性力量,通过跨性别机制将模型偏向于所显示的性别,而跨性别机制不成比例地降低了相反性别的表现。 这种效果出现在图像字幕和代词预测中,而不是在视觉问题回答中,表明性别化的ICL只有在任务输出涉及性别化语言时才会影响偏差. 基于相似性的检索方法继承了培训人才库的性别不平衡,不提供偏离优势,而标准的质量衡量标准却对这些偏见的转变视而不见。 为了减少这种偏差,我们用稳定的传播模型的合成图像取代真实的内文本图像,同时保持标题不变。 这种简单的干预可以减少性别偏见,而不降低标题质量。 代码见:https://github.com/mathfather/Gender-Bias-in-VL-ICL。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are multimodal extensions of Large Language Models (LLMs) [ 34 ] . Recent LVLMs [ 37 , 56 ] can take interleaved image-text data as input [ 1 ] , enabling in-context learning (ICL) which adapts model outputs based on a few demonstration examples without fine-tuning [ 9 , 12 ] . A substantial body of work [ 9 , 52 , 61 , 65 ] has explored ICL for vision-language tasks such as image captioning [ 48 ] and visual question answering (VQA) [ 3 ] . However, prior work has highlighted gender bias in LVLMs, raising concerns about their real-world impact [ 21 ] . Furthermore, biased contexts are found to exacerbate these issues by amplifying underlying model biases during inference [ 11 ] . These findings lead to the question: How does ICL influence gender bias in LVLMs?
blocks.zh: 大型远景-语言模型(LVLMs)是大型语言模型(LLMs)的多式联运扩展[34]. 最近的LVLM[37,56]可以将互开的图像文本数据作为输入[1],使内文本学习(ICL)能够根据几个演示实例调整模型输出,而不进行微调[9,12]. 大量工作[9、52、61、65]探讨了ICL的视觉语言任务,如图像字幕[48]和视觉问题回答(VQA)[3]。 然而,先前的工作突出了低排放和低排放物质中的性别偏见,使人们对其现实世界的影响感到关切[21]。 此外,在推论中,有偏见的情况会扩大基本的模型偏见,从而加剧这些问题。 这些调查结果导致一个问题: ICL如何影响LVLMs中的性别偏见?.

blocks.en: To address this question, we propose V ision- L anguage Gender B ias in ICL E valuation (VL-BICLE), a systematic evaluation framework comprising four gender-composition and two similarity-based ICL settings, evaluated across three vision-language tasks (image captioning, pronoun prediction, and VQA) on four datasets. Experiments on six LVLMs reveal several key findings. Gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force: male-only context pushes models toward male bias 1 1 1 We refer to the case where an LVLM favors male samples over female ones as male bias , and the reverse as female bias . while female-only context pushes toward female bias, regardless of the model’s baseline bias direction, sometimes flipping it entirely. This shift stems from a cross-gender mechanism where gendered demonstrations disproportionately degrade performance on the opposite gender. Similarity-based retrieval methods inherit demographic imbalances from their source pool and offer no debiasing advantage over random selection. Standard caption quality metrics remain stable even as gender bias shifts substantially. These gendered ICL effects, observed in captioning and pronoun prediction, are absent in VQA, indicating that ICL influences gender bias only when the task output involves gendered language. Finally, by replacing real demonstration images with synthetic ones from stable diffusion models (SDMs), we explore a simple yet effective gender bias mitigation method, which works across most models without degrading caption quality and is consistent across two different SDMs.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Bias Mitigation in LVLMs Societal bias has been observed across vision-and-language tasks including image captioning [ 2 , 19 , 46 , 15 , 62 ] , text-to-image search [ 49 ] , and VQA [ 18 ] , with studies showing that multimodal models can perpetuate stereotypes [ 24 ] and that LVLMs exacerbate gender bias in downstream tasks [ 17 ] . Several mitigation approaches have been proposed [ 49 , 7 , 58 , 22 ] , yet most target Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP [ 42 ] rather than LVLMs. The few LVLM-focused methods rely on post-hoc logit calibration [ 59 ] or inference-time steering [ 43 ] , but their effectiveness remains inconsistent across tasks [ 36 , 57 ] .
blocks.zh: 在视觉和语言任务中,人们观察到了对LVLMs的社会偏见,包括图像标题[2、19、46、15、62]、文本到图像搜索[49]和VQA[18],研究表明,多式联运模式可延续定型观念[24],LVLM在下游任务中加剧了性别偏见[17]。 提出了若干缓解方针[49、7、58、22],但大多数目标是愿景-语言模型,如CLIP[42],而不是LVLM。 为数不多的LVLM重点方法依赖后记录校准[59]或推断时间指导[43],但其有效性在任务[36,57]之间仍然不一致.

blocks.en: ICL for LVLMs ICL [ 51 ] , originally used in natural language tasks [ 9 ] , is defined as a paradigm that allows language models to perform tasks given only a few examples in the form of demonstrations [ 12 ] . Inspired by the advances of LLMs in ICL [ 52 , 61 , 53 ] , researchers have begun to extend the idea to other modalities. Some initial studies explored ICL in purely visual settings, where vision models perform visual tasks ( e.g . , segmentation, detection) via image inpainting, conditioned on a few image demonstrations without task-specific fine-tuning [ 6 , 60 ] . More recently, with the proposal of multimodal models enabled with vision-language ICL [ 1 , 33 , 66 ] and trained on interleaved image-text datasets [ 5 , 28 , 29 , 63 ] , increasing efforts have been devoted to enhancing the ICL performance in these LVLMs [ 13 , 65 ] . Still, how ICL impacts LVLMs during generation is not yet well understood [ 5 , 32 ] . While a few efforts have been devoted to optimizing in-context sequences to enhance ICL performance, such as retrieving representative examples [ 55 , 30 ] or training a small assistant model for sample selection and ranking [ 54 ] , these approaches do not aim to mitigate the societal biases present in LVLMs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to analyze how ICL affects gender bias in LVLMs.
blocks.zh: LVLMs ICL [51],最初用于自然语言任务[9],被定义为一种范式,允许语言模型执行仅以演示形式给出的几个例子[12]. 受法学硕士在ICL[52,61,53]的进步的启发,研究人员开始将这一想法推广到其他方式. 一些初步研究在纯粹的视觉环境下探索了ICL,其中视觉模型通过图像涂层来完成视觉任务(例如分解,检测),以一些没有特定任务微调的图像演示为条件[6,60]. 最近,由于提出了使用视线语言ICL[1、33、66]的多式联运模型,并接受了关于互页图像文本数据集[5、28、29、63]的培训,因此已加紧努力,提高这些LVLM的ICL性能[13、65]。 然而,对ICL如何在一代人中影响LVLM尚不十分了解[5,32]. 虽然已作出一些努力,优化内容序列,以提高国际液化工艺的性能,例如检索有代表性的实例[55、30],或培训一个小的选样和排位助理模型[54],但这些方法并不旨在减轻低压成份中存在的社会偏见。 据我们所知,这是第一个分析ICL如何影响LVLMs中的性别偏见的研究.

Although SBRs have not been previously applied to gender bias analysis in LVLMs, these methods are among the few approaches explored for in-context example selection in vision-language tasks [ 54 ] , and have demonstrated effectiveness in enhancing ICL performance. The ICL settings are illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于SIIR和SITR来说,最相似的样本放在更接近查询的地方. 虽然在LVLM中SBR没有被用于性别偏差分析,但这些方法属于为在视觉语言任务中选择内在实例而探索的少数方法之一[54],并显示出提高ICL性能的有效性. ICL设置在图1中显示.

blocks.en: 3.3 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集

blocks.en: We present the four datasets used in VL-BICLE, summarized in Tab. 1 . All datasets provide explicit gender labels (either manually annotated or deterministically inferred from the available text), and the captioning and VQA datasets are further filtered to single-person images. Each dataset is split into a training set (used as the ICL demonstration pool) and a validation set (used for evaluation): the training set preserves the original gender distribution, while the validation set is designed to be gender-balanced. Notably, all four datasets elicit natural outputs (free-form captions or unconstrained next-token predictions), better reflecting real-world model behavior and avoiding artifacts introduced by constrained formats ( e.g . , multiple-choice [ 31 ] ). See Appendix 0.A for details on data processing.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍在VL-BICLE中使用的四套数据集,摘要见Tab。 1,所有数据集都提供明确的性别标签(无论是手动附加说明还是从现有文本中断然推断),标题和VQA数据集被进一步过滤到单人图像. 每个数据集被分为一组培训(用作ICL演示池)和一组认证(用于评价):培训集保留了最初的性别分布,而验证集则设计为性别平衡. 值得注意的是,所有四个数据集都引申出自然输出(自由形式字幕或不受约束的下个托肯预测),更好地反映现实世界的模型行为,并避免受约束格式引入的文物(如多选择[31]). 关于数据处理的详细情况,见附录0.A。

blocks.en: VisoGender VisoGender [ 14 ] contains images of people in 23 occupational settings, each annotated with a perceived binary gender label. Two sub-tasks are defined: Occupation-Object (OO), a single-subject image paired with a possessive pronoun referring to a professional object ( e.g . , the doctor and his/her stethoscope ); and Occupation-Participant (OP), a two-subject image paired with a possessive pronoun referring to a secondary participant ( e.g . , the doctor and his/her patient ). During inference, given a query image and a template prefix ( e.g . , The doctor and [ next-token ]), we obtain the next-token distribution and compare the probabilities of his and her to determine the predicted gender.
blocks.zh: Viso Gender Viso Gender[14] 包含23个职业环境中的人的图像,每幅图片都带有一个感知的二进制性别标签. 界定了两个子任务:职业-对象(OO),一个单一主体图像与涉及专业对象的占有式代词(如医生及其听诊器)对齐;职业-参与者(OP),一个双主体图像与涉及二级参与者的占有式代词对齐(如医生及其病人)。 在推论中,给一个查询图像和一个模板前缀(如:医生和[邻接 ),我们得到了下一个的分布,并比较他和她的概率以确定预测的性别.

blocks.en: COCOBias We use the gender-annotated subset of MSCOCO [ 10 ] released by Zhao et al . [ 62 ] , which we refer to as COCOBias. We filter the dataset to retain only single-person samples with unambiguous gender labels. During evaluation, models generate a free-form caption for each query image, and the predicted gender is inferred from the generated text using predefined gender word lists that we extend from those used in [ 19 ] ; the word lists are presented in Appendix 0.B .
blocks.zh: 可可比亚斯 我们使用赵等人发布的MSCOCO[10]的性别说明子集[62],我们称之为COCOBias. 我们过滤数据集,只保留带有明确性别标签的单人样本。 在评价期间,模型为每个查询图像生成一个自由格式标题,预测的性别从生成的文本中推断出来,使用我们从[19]中使用的性别词列表延伸出来的预定义性别词列表;词列表载于附录0.B.

blocks.en: DCI Densely Captioned Images (DCI) [ 47 ] contains images from SA-1B [ 26 ] with dense, human-annotated captions. Similar to COCOBias, we filter the dataset to contain only single-person images, yielding a subset of 371 images that is split into a training pool and a gender-balanced validation set. During evaluation, models generate a free-form caption for each query image, and the predicted gender is inferred using the same word lists as COCOBias.
blocks.zh: 保卫国际 感性地标注图像(DCI)[47]包含来自SA-1B[26]的图像,带有密集的,人性化的注释性字幕. 与COCOBias类似,我们过滤数据集只包含单人图像,产生371个图像的子集,它们被分成一个训练池和一个性别平衡的验证集. 在评价期间,模型为每个查询图像生成自由格式标题,并使用与COCOBias相同的单词列表来推断预测的性别.

blocks.en: VisualCoT VisualCoT [ 44 ] provides chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning annotations for VQA; here we use its GQA [ 23 ] subset, which contains human images. Each ICL demonstration comprises an image, a question, an optional multi-step reasoning path, and a short answer (see Sec. 0.C.3 for the prompts). We conduct two types of inference: with CoT and without CoT (direct); inference without CoT directly outputs an answer given the input, while inference with CoT produces intermediate reasoning steps before the final answer. To mitigate textual gender leakage during evaluation, test queries are neutralized (replacing explicit gender words with neutral ones, e.g . , man → \rightarrow person ) while ICL demonstrations retain their original gendered phrasing, isolating the effect of ICL context from explicit gender cues.
blocks.zh: VisualCoT VisualCoT [44] 为VQA提供思维链(COT)推理说明;在此我们使用它的GQA [23]子集,包含人类图像. 每个ICL演示包括一个图像,一个问题,一个可选的多步推理路径,以及一个简短的答案(请参看催眠符的0.C.3sec. 我们进行两类推论:与CoT和不与CoT(直接);在没有CoT直接输出一个给输入的答案的推论,而与CoT的推论在最终答案之前产生中间推理步骤. 为了减少评价过程中的文字性别渗漏,测试询问被中和(用中性语言取代明确的性别词,例如,男性 ),而ICL 演示则保留其最初的性别措辞,将ICL语境的影响与明确的性别提示隔离开来。

blocks.en: Performance Metrics For image captioning performance evaluation, we utilize the reference-based metric BLEU-4 [ 39 , 40 ] , which requires human-written captions as ground-truth references. We also apply a reference-free metric, CLIPScore [ 16 ] , which relies on the image-text matching of the pre-trained CLIP [ 42 ] . Pronoun prediction does not require a performance metric as we sample the probability of tokens from the latent output space. For VQA, the quality of the generated answer is already evaluated within the bias metrics.
blocks.zh: 性能测量 在图像字幕方面,我们使用基于参考的BLEU-4[39,40],它要求用人写字幕作为地面真实的参考。 我们还采用无参考度量衡CLIPScore[16],它依赖于预训CLIP[42]的图像文本匹配. 代词预测不需要一个性能度量,因为我们从潜在输出空间中取样了信物的概率. 对于VQA,生成的答案的质量已经在偏差度量内进行了评价.

blocks.en: Statistical Metrics We additionally report two statistics: (1) for image captioning, the average caption length (AvgL) provides a coarse measure of stylistic similarity to the reference captions; and (2) for image captioning and pronoun prediction, the reveal rate (RR) measures the proportion of samples in which the LVLM explicitly mentions gender. We define a per-sample binary indicator r i ∈ { 0 , 1 } r_{i}\in\{0,1\} , where r i = 1 r_{i}=1 if the model output contains an explicit gender mention and r i = 0 r_{i}=0 otherwise; gender-grouped reveal rates are then defined in Eq. 4 :

blocks.en: LVLMs We examine how ICL impacts gender bias during generation across six widely used LVLMs: Qwen-VL (QwenVL) [ 4 ] , Idefics3-8B-Llama3 (Idefics3) [ 27 ] , Phi-3.5-vision-instruct (Phi35V) [ 35 ] , MiniCPM-o 2.6 (MiniCPM) [ 56 ] , InternVL3.5-8B (InternVL35) [ 50 ] , and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (Qwen3VL) [ 41 ] . These models support interleaved image-text inputs, which is necessary for evaluation under multimodal ICL settings. All LVLMs used have publicly available checkpoints. We evaluate all six models on all datasets, except for VisualCoT: here we evaluate only MiniCPM, Phi35V, and Qwen3VL, as only these three models are observed to have both consistent pattern-following ability and reasonable inference speed. More details regarding models can be found in Appendix 0.D .
blocks.zh: 低强度 我们研究了ICL如何在一代人的时间里对六个广泛使用的LVLM产生性别偏见:Quen-VL(QuenVL)[4],Idefics3-8B-Llama3(Idefics3)[27],Phi-3.5-视觉指令(Phi35V)[35],MiniCPM-o 2.6(MiniCPM)[56],InternVL3.5-8B(InternVL35)[50],以及Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct(Quen3VL)[41]。 这些模型支持互页图像文本输入,这是在多式联运综合语言设置下进行评价所必需的。 使用的所有LVLM都设有可公开使用的检查站。 除了VisualCoT之外,我们评价所有六个模型:这里我们只评价MiniCPM,Phi35V,和Quen3VL,因为只有这三个模型被观测到既具有一致的跟随规律的能力,又具有合理的推论速度. 关于模型的更多详情,见附录0.D。

blocks.en: Inference Details Our experiments are conducted under k k -shot settings for k ∈ { 0 , 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 } k\in\{0,2,4,6,8\} . All experiments use greedy search during inference. The first four ICL settings (RS, MS, FS, BS) are applied to all datasets. SIIR and SITR are applied only to COCOBias as VisoGender and VisualCoT lack the descriptive captions that SITR requires and the demonstration pool of DCI is too small for meaningful similarity-based selection. For RS, MS, FS, and BS, we run each experiment five times using independently sampled in-context sequences 𝒮 t k \mathcal{S}_{t}^{k} from the training set, where 𝒮 t k \mathcal{S}_{t}^{k} is obtained by extending 𝒮 t k − 2 \mathcal{S}_{t}^{k-2} with two additional examples. For SIIR and SITR, since the in-context examples are retrieved deterministically, each setting is conducted only once. See Appendix 0.E for details.
blocks.zh: 推论细节 我们的实验是在 k k- shoot 设置下进行的 k {} { 0, 2, 4, 6, 8} k\\\\ 0, 2, 4, 6, 8} 。 所有实验在推论中都使用贪婪的搜索. 头四个ICL设置(RS,MS,FS,BS)适用于所有数据集. SIIR和SITR仅适用于COCOBias,因为Viso Gender和VisualCoT缺乏SITR所要求的描述性标题,DCI的演示池太小,无法进行有意义的基于相似性的选择. 对于RS,MS,FS,和BS,我们使用从训练集中独立抽取的缩写序列S t k\mathcal{S}_{t}^{k}进行五次实验,其中通过扩展S t k−2\mathcal{S}_{t}^{k-2}获得S t k\mathcal{S}_{t}^{k},另外有两个例子. 对于 SIIR 和 SITR ,由于内文实例是决定性的检索,因此每个设置只进行一次. 详情见附录0.E。

blocks.en: Evaluation Details For COCOBias, the predicted gender is inferred from each generated caption via keyword matching against pre-defined gender word lists. A sample is counted as an error ( e i = 1 e_{i}=1 ) if the caption mentions the wrong gender, or if it mentions both genders at once (since we only use single-person images for image captioning); captions containing no gendered term are treated as unrevealed and correct ( r i = 0 r_{i}=0 , e i = 0 e_{i}=0 ). For VisoGender, the predicted gender is derived from the next-token probabilities of his versus her ; a mismatch with the ground-truth counts as an error, while ties are assigned e i = 0 e_{i}=0 with r i = 0 r_{i}=0 . For VisualCoT, no gender is inferred from the model’s output; gender labels serve only to define evaluation subgroups. Following the evaluation procedure of Shao et al . [ 44 ] , each answer is assessed by GPT-OSS-20B [ 38 ] in an LLM-as-judge manner (see Appendix 0.F for more details) that scores the semantic similarity between the predicted and ground-truth answers, resulting in a score s i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{i}\in[0,1] , and the per-sample error is defined as e i = 1 − s i e_{i}=1-s_{i} . All ER and RR values are reported as percentages throughout the following sections.

blocks.en: 4.1 Analysis with VL-BICLE
blocks.zh: 4.1 与VL-BICLE的分析

blocks.en: Full results are in Appendices 0.H , 0.J , 0.K and 0.L . We summarize the main observations below.
blocks.zh: 全部结果载于附录0.H、0.J、0.K和0.L。 我们总结以下主要意见。

blocks.en: Baseline gender bias varies across datasets and tasks The sign and magnitude of ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} at zero-shot ( k = 0 k{=}0 ) depend on the model, dataset, and task. Among all models, Idefics3 shows consistent male bias, and InternVL35 never presents female bias. In image captioning, only Idefics3 shows a consistent gender preference across COCOBias and DCI; three of the six models (QwenVL, MiniCPM, and Qwen3VL) evaluated on both datasets reverse direction between them. Across tasks, Phi35V is nearly unbiased in captioning ( ER m − f = − 0.09 \text{ER}_{m-f}=-0.09 on COCOBias) yet strongly female-biased in pronoun prediction ( ER m − f = 13.04 \text{ER}_{m-f}=13.04 on VisoGender-OO). These inconsistencies suggest that diagnosing a model’s gender bias from a single dataset or task [ 15 , 62 ] risks overgeneralizing findings that are specific to the dataset and task at hand. Table 2 reports the full zero-shot baselines across all datasets and tasks.
blocks.zh: 各种数据集和任务对基线的性别偏见各不相同 ER m - f\text{ER}_{m-f}在0-shot(k = 0 k{=}0)时的标志和大小取决于模型,数据集和任务. 在所有模型中,IDEDICS3表现出一贯的男性偏见,InternVL35从未呈现女性偏见. 在图像标题中,只有IDEDICS3显示整个COCOBias和DCI始终具有性别偏好;在两个数据集上评价的6个模型中有3个(QuenVL、MiniCPM和Quen3VL)。 在各项任务中,Phi35V在标题(ER m − f = − 0.09\text{ER}_{m-f}= − 0.09 on COBias)中几乎没有偏见,但在代词预测中却存在强烈的女性偏见(ER m − f = 13.04\text{ER}_{m-f}=13.04 on Viso Gender-OO). 这些不一致之处表明,从单一的数据集或任务[15、62]中诊断一个模型的性别偏见,有可能过分概括与当前数据集和任务具体有关的调查结果。 表2报告所有数据集和任务的全部零射基线。

blocks.en: Gendered ICL shifts bias toward the demonstrated gender Across image captioning and pronoun prediction tasks, MS consistently shifts Δ ​ ER m − f k := ER m − f k − ER m − f 0 \Delta\text{ER}_{m-f}^{k}:=\text{ER}_{m-f}^{k}-\text{ER}_{m-f}^{0} negative (toward male bias), while FS shifts it positive (toward female bias); see Fig. 2 . The effect is especially pronounced in pronoun prediction: on VisoGender-OP, all models show positive Δ ​ ER m − f k = 8 \Delta\text{ER}_{m-f}^{k=8} under FS, while five of six models show negative Δ ​ ER m − f k \Delta\text{ER}_{m-f}^{k} under MS; a similar pattern holds for OO. For image captioning, the same directional pattern holds but with smaller effect sizes: under FS, all six models shift positive on DCI and four of six on COCOBias; under MS, five of six models show negative Δ ​ ER m − f k \Delta\text{ER}_{m-f}^{k} on COCOBias at 8-shot (only Qwen3VL shifts positive). This directional shift is generally reliable: it holds regardless of the model’s baseline bias direction. Even models that are female-biased at zero-shot ( e.g . , Phi35V and Qwen3VL in pronoun prediction) are pushed toward male bias by MS (see Appendix 0.K ). This indicates that single-gendered ICL is a directional force, rather than a debiasing tool; it can flip the bias to the opposite gender ( e.g . , ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} for MiniCPM flips from − 27.5 -27.5 at zero-shot to 27.2 27.2 under 8-shot FS on VisoGender-OO).

blocks.en: Gendered ICL hurts performance on the opposite gender The directional bias shift described above arises from a consistent cross-gender mechanism: gendered ICL demonstrations hurt performance on the opposite gender more than on the demonstrated gender. For example, under MS where only male examples are used in the context, ER f \text{ER}_{f} rises while ER m \text{ER}_{m} stays relatively flat; similarly under FS, ER m \text{ER}_{m} rises while ER f \text{ER}_{f} is preserved ( Fig. 3 ). The same effect is present in both captioning and pronoun prediction yet differs in magnitude. In image captioning, the effect is modest: at 8-shot on COCOBias, the largest ER f \text{ER}_{f} difference between MS and FS is 1.46 on Phi35V (2.25 under MS vs . 0.79 under FS); in pronoun prediction, the same mechanism produces gaps an order of magnitude larger: on VisoGender-OP at 8-shot, ER f \text{ER}_{f} under MS reaches 85.5 for QwenVL (compared to 9.7 under FS), and ER m \text{ER}_{m} under FS reaches 67.5 for Phi35V (compared to 9.4 under MS). Overall, the cross-gender effect is broadly robust; at 8-shot, five of six models exhibit it across both COCOBias and DCI in captioning, and all six models show it on both VisoGender subtasks. Qwen3VL is the only exception in captioning: it shows no cross-gender effect at any shot count on either dataset, because of its overall low error rates for both genders.
blocks.zh: 性别的ICL对性别的成绩不利 上述方向性偏差的转变源于一个一贯的跨性别机制:具有性别色彩的ICL示威对相反性别的表现的伤害大于所显示的性别。 例如,在上下文中只使用男性实例的MS下,ER f\text{ER}_{f}在ER m\text{ER}_{m}保持相对平坦的同时上升;同样在FS下,ER m\text{ER}_{m}在ER f\text{ER}_{f}保存时上升(图3). 标题和代词预测中都存在同样的效果,但规模不同。 在图像标题方面,效果不大:在COCOBias上8拍,MS和FS最大的ER f\text{ER}_{f}差值在Phi35V上为1.46(MS下2.25对FS下0.79);在代词预测中,同一机制产生一个较大的缺口:在Viso Gender-OP上8拍,ER f\text{ER}_{f}在MS下达到85.5对QuenVL(FS下9.7),在FS下ER m\text{ER}_{m}达到67.5对Phi35V(MS下9.4)。 总的来说,跨性别效应大体强劲;在8点,6个模型中有5个在COCOBias和DCI的字幕中展示,所有6个模型都在Viso性别子任务中展示。 Qune3VL是标题的唯一例外:它没有显示在任意一次计算两个数据集时的跨性别效果,因为它对两个性别的误差率总体较低。

blocks.en: SBR methods inherit the training set’s gender imbalance SIIR and SITR select ICL examples by semantic similarity rather than controlling for gender composition. Since the original pool of COCOBias is male-skewed, both SBR methods over-select male examples and produce bias levels comparable to (or exceeding) those of MS (as shown in Fig. 4 ). At 8-shot, Phi35V under SIIR and SITR yields ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} of − - 2.25 and − - 2.35, respectively, showing more male bias than male-only ICL ( − - 1.88 ± \pm 1.03). For InternVL35 and MiniCPM, ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} under SIIR and SITR remains within one standard deviation of RS, suggesting that retrieval-based methods, though male-skewed, have little additional effect on these models. Qwen3VL, which has shown little sensitivity to gendered ICL in image captioning, behaves similarly under SIIR and SITR: ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} remains near its baseline across all VL-BICLE settings. Overall, SIIR and SITR produce similar gender bias levels, and neither method is consistently more biased than the other. Furthermore, both SBR methods cannot consistently outperform MS regarding ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} , suggesting that SBR methods offer no debiasing advantage. To separate the effect of the pool’s composition from that of the SBR mechanism itself, we additionally run both methods over a down-sampled, gender-balanced pool (balanced pool in Fig. 4 ; full results in Appendix 0.I ). Using a balanced pool recovers part of the gap opened by retrieval on the original pool, confirming that pool composition is one of the main reasons for gender bias; however, the recovery is only partial: QwenVL, Idefics3, and Phi35V underperform BS consistently on both SBR methods, indicating that these methods can still reintroduce bias even from a balanced pool, since the top- k k retrieval does not force the retrieved context itself to be gender unbiased.
blocks.zh: SBR方法继承了训练集的性别不平衡 SIIR和SITR通过语义相似而不是控制性别构成来选择ICL的例子. 由于最初的COCOBias池是男性操纵的,所以SBR两种方法都过度选择男性例子,产生与MS的偏差水平相当(或超过)(如图4所示). 8拍时,SIIR下的Phi35V和SITR的产量ER − f\text{ER}_{m-f}分别为−2.25和−2.35,显示男性偏好多于仅雄性的ICL(− - 1.88±\\pm 1.03). 对于InternVL35和MiniCPM,SIIR和SITR下的ER m − f\text{ER}_{m-f}仍然在RS的一个标准偏差范围内,说明基于检索的方法虽然是男性的,但对这些模型几乎没有什么额外影响. Qwen3VL 在图像标题中显示对性别化的ICL不太敏感, 在 SIIR 和 SITR 下表现类似 : ER m - f\ text{ER}_{m-f} 在所有 VL- BICLE 设置中仍然接近基线 。 总体而言,SIIR和SITR产生类似的性别偏差水平,而且这两种方法都始终比其他方法更偏差. 此外,两种SBR方法在ER m-f\text{ER}_{m-f}方面都无法一贯地超过MS,这表明SBR方法不会产生贬低优势. 为了将人才库的组成与SBR机制本身的作用区分开来,我们又将两种方法都放在一个经下取样的、性别平衡的人才库上(图4中的人才库;附录0.I中的全部结果)。 使用平衡池恢复原池上检索所打开的部分缺口,证实池组成是性别偏见的主要原因之一;然而,回收只是部分原因:QuenVL, Idefics3,以及Phi35V在SBR两种方法上一贯表现不佳的BS,表明这些方法即使从平衡池中仍然可能重新出现偏差,因为上-k k检索不会迫使检索的上下文本身没有性别偏见.

blocks.en: Caption quality metrics do not track gender bias As shown in Tab. 3 and Appendices 0.H and 0.J , standard caption quality metrics remain largely stable across ICL settings even as gender bias shifts substantially. CLIPScore is the most insensitive: across all six models, two image captioning datasets, and all shot counts, the largest cross-experiment range of CLIPScore is 0.67, negligible relative to metric means (which lie between 25 and 35). BLEU-4 and AvgL show some variation across ICL settings for certain models, but this variation does not correlate with the direction or magnitude of gender bias shifts. BLEU-4 and CLIPScore gaps between male and female subsets are similarly uninformative: they fluctuate near zero without systematic patterns, even when ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} shifts markedly. These results indicate that quality metrics cannot serve as proxies for gender bias.
blocks.zh: 如图3和附录0.H和0.J所示,尽管性别偏见发生了很大变化,但各国际天主教法律学院的标准标题质量衡量标准仍然基本稳定。 CLIPScore是最不敏感的:在所有6个模型中,两个图像字幕数据集,以及所有镜头计数中,CLIPScore的最大交叉实验范围是0.67,相对于度量手段(介于25到35之间)可忽略不计. BLEU-4和AvgL显示某些模型在ICL设置上有一些差异,但这种差异与性别偏见变化的方向或程度无关。 BLEU-4和CLIPScore在雄性和雌性子集之间的差距同样不具有信息性:它们没有系统规律地在接近零时波动,即使在ER m − f\text{ER}_{m-f}明显转移时也是如此. 这些结果表明,质量衡量标准不能作为性别偏见的代名词。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : ICL gender composition does not affect gender bias performance on VQA.
blocks.zh: 图5:ICL性别构成不影响VQA上的性别偏见表现.

blocks.en: Gendered ICL effects are absent in VQA The gendered ICL effects observed in image captioning and pronoun prediction do not directly transfer to VQA. As shown in Fig. 5 , all four ICL settings (RS, MS, FS, BS) produce nearly identical ER m \text{ER}_{m} and ER f \text{ER}_{f} across all shot counts and all three models tested, regardless of the prompting style. In particular, ER m \text{ER}_{m} and ER f \text{ER}_{f} move in the same direction rather than in opposite directions across settings, so the underlying bias is essentially unchanged ( ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} differs by at most 1.82 across settings), indicating that gendered ICL neither widens nor narrows the gender bias gap. Within VL-BICLE, where the models, ICL settings, and gender composition are held constant across tasks, we can reasonably attribute such contrast to the task’s output space: gendered ICL influences gender bias level only when the task output involves gendered language.
blocks.zh: VQA中没有性别的ICL效应 在图像字幕和代词预测中观察到的性别化的ICL效应并不直接转移到VQA. 如图5所示,所有四种ICL设置(RS,MS,FS,BS)在所有镜头计数和测试的所有三种型号中都产生几乎完全相同的ER m\text{ER}_{m}和ER f\text{ER}_{f},无论提示风格如何. 特别是,ER m\text{ER}_{m}和ER f\text{ER}_{f}在不同的设置中朝着同一个方向,而不是相反的方向移动,因此基本没有改变潜在的偏差(ER m - f\text{ER}_{m-f}在不同的设置中最多有1.82个不同),表明性别的ICL既不扩大也不缩小性别偏差. 在VL-BICLE中,模型、ICL设置和性别构成在任务之间保持不变,因此我们可以合理地将这种对比归因于任务的产出空间:性别的ICL只有在任务产出涉及性别语言时才会影响性别偏差水平。

blocks.en: 5 Bias Mitigation
blocks.zh: 5 减轻偏见

blocks.en: Figure 6 : CLIPScore and reveal rate RR o \text{RR}_{o} across three visual distributions (COCOBias, FLUX, SD35L) at 2-shot and 4-shot under MS and FS settings. CLIPScore remains stable while reveal rate drops with synthetic images.
blocks.zh: 图6:CLIPScore和显示速率RR o\text{RR}_{o}在MS和FS设置下在3个视觉分布(COCOBias,FLUX,SD35L)进行2发和4发. CLIPScore保持稳定,同时以合成图像显示速率下降。

blocks.en: The preceding experiments show that the gender composition of ICL examples systematically shifts model behavior. To mitigate the effect of these contextual details, we replace real images with synthetic ones generated using SDMs, as gendered image generation allows for more control over what the image contains via the prompt. Specifically, given a dataset 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} consisting of N N image-caption pairs, we utilize the captions as input to an SDM to generate corresponding synthetic images, thus forming a synthetic dataset 𝒟 s \mathcal{D}_{s} of synthetic image-caption pairs; we ensure that the captions used for image generation contain explicit gender words. Subsequently, we replicate the MS and FS settings of VL-BICLE, except that the in-context examples are now sampled from 𝒟 s \mathcal{D}_{s} rather than 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} . For synthetic image generation, we employ two SDMs, FLUX [ 8 ] and Stable Diffusion-3.5-Large (SD35L) [ 45 ] . Since generation runs once offline over the sampling pool, no SDM is involved at inference time. More details regarding the experiment settings are shown in Appendix 0.G , and the full per-model results in Appendix 0.M .
blocks.zh: 前面的实验表明,ICL的例子的性别组成系统地改变了模型行为. 为了减轻这些背景细节的影响,我们用使用SDM生成的合成图像取代真实的图像,因为有性别色彩的图像生成能够通过提示对图像包含的内容进行更多的控制。 具体地说,鉴于由N N 图像封装对组成的数据集D t \ mathcal{D}_{t},我们利用这些标题作为SDM的输入,生成相应的合成图像,从而形成合成图像封装对的合成数据集D s\ mathcal{D}_{s};我们确保用于图像生成的字幕包含明显的性别词。 随后,我们复制了 VL-BICLE 的 MS 和 FS 设置,只是现在从 D s\mathcal{D}_{s} 而不是 D t\mathcal{D}_{t} 中抽取了内文实例 。 在合成图像生成方面,我们采用了两个SDM,即FLUX[8]和稳定扩散-3.5-Large(SD35L)[45]。 由于世代一度在取样池上下线,因此在推论时没有涉及SDM。 有关实验设置的更多细节载于附录0.G,每个模型的全部结果载于附录0.M。

blocks.en: Caption quality stays stable while reveal rate drops Fig. 6 compares CLIPScore and reveal rate RR o \text{RR}_{o} across two ICL settings with three different image distributions. CLIPScore remains stable across all tested models and settings, with differences typically within 0.5, confirming that replacing real context images with synthetic ones does not degrade caption quality. Reveal rate, however, decreases with synthetic context images for most models.
blocks.zh: 标题质量保持稳定,同时显示速率下降图. Fig. 6比较了CLIPScore,并在两个ICL设置中将RR o\text{RR}_{o}显示速率与三种不同的图像分布. CLIPScore在所有经过测试的模型和设置中保持稳定,差异一般在0.5以内,证实用合成图像取代真实上下文图像不会降低标题质量。 然而,随着大多数模型的合成上下文图像,揭示率下降。

blocks.en: Gender bias is reduced on revealed samples when using synthetic images Evaluation results on ER m − f \text{ER}_{m-f} show that using synthetic images (both FLUX and SD35L) yields better gender bias performance. Since RR o \text{RR}_{o} drops with synthetic images, it is natural to question: does the superiority of using SDM-generated images come from the lower reveal rate (where LVLMs become more cautious about revealing gender, leading to loss of information density), or is it genuinely better? To control for this, we evaluate bias on revealed samples only. Tab. 4 reports | ER m − f | |\text{ER}_{m-f}| conditioned on samples where the model does reveal gender ( r i = 1 r_{i}=1 ). With in-context synthetic images, | ER m − f | |\text{ER}_{m-f}| decreases relative to the baseline for three of the four LVLMs under both MS and FS settings. FLUX and SD35L yield similar reductions, suggesting the effect stems from using synthetic images rather than a specific generator. These results suggest that the visual content of ICL context images influences gender bias in model outputs, even though it has little effect on caption quality. Replacing real photographs with synthetic images offers a simple intervention: it reduces gender bias on revealed samples, without requiring changes to the example selection procedure or the caption text.
blocks.zh: 当使用合成图像对ER m - f\text{ER}_{m-f}的评价结果显示使用合成图像(FLUX和SD35L)能产生更好的性别偏差时,所揭示的样本上的性别偏差会减少。 由于RR o\text{RR}_{o}与合成图像一起下降,因此自然会产生疑问:使用SDM生成的图像的优越性是否来自较低的曝光率(其中LVLMs对揭示性别更加谨慎,导致信息密度的丧失),还是真正更好? 为了控制这种情况,我们只评估暴露样本的偏差。 Tab. 4报告 ER m - f QQ text{ER}_{m-f}| 以模型确实显示性别的样本为条件(r i = 1 r_{i}=1). 以内文本合成图像,在MS和FS设置下,QQ ER m − f → text{ER}_{m-f}| 相对于四个LVLM中的三个LVLM的基线减少. FLUX和SD35L产生类似的减量,说明这种效应源于使用合成图像而不是特定的生成器. 这些结果表明,ICL上下文图像的视觉内容影响了模型产出中的性别偏见,尽管它对标题质量影响不大。 用合成图像取代真实照片提供了一个简单的干预:它减少了所披露样本上的性别偏见,而不需要修改实例选择程序或标题文本。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented VL-BICLE, a systematic evaluation framework for analyzing how ICL influences gender bias in LVLMs across three tasks and four datasets. Across six LVLMs, gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force, pushing bias toward the demonstrated gender through a cross-gender mechanism that degrades performance on the opposite gender. This effect holds in image captioning and pronoun prediction but is absent in VQA. SBR methods inherit their source pool’s imbalance and offer no debiasing advantage, while quality metrics remain blind to these shifts. Replacing real in-context images with SDM-generated ones reduces gender bias without degrading caption quality. We hope that VL-BICLE and our findings encourage more careful consideration of context composition in ICL-based applications of LVLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VL-BICLE,这是一个系统评价框架,用于分析ICL如何在LVLM中影响性别偏见,涉及三项任务和四项数据集。 在六个LVLM中,有性别倾向的ICL示威是一种方向性力量,通过一种跨性别机制,对所表现的性别产生偏见,使反性别的表现下降。 这种效果存在于图像标题和代词预测中,但在VQA中缺失. SBR方法继承了源池的不平衡,没有削弱优势,而质量衡量标准却对这些变化视而不见。 用SDM生成的文本中真实的图像来取代,可以减少性别偏见,而不降低标题质量。 我们希望,VL-BICLE和我们的调查结果鼓励更仔细地考虑在基于ICL的LVLM应用中的背景构成.

blocks.en: 0.A.1 VisoGender
blocks.zh: 0.A.1 维索性别

blocks.en: The original VisoGender [ 14 ] benchmark provides 230 Occupation-Object (OO) and 460 Occupation-Participant (OP) annotations across 23 occupations. Of the 690 original annotations, 670 images remain accessible. We split each sub-task using stratified sampling by occupation and gender: for OO, we sample two images per occupation per perceived gender for training (92 total); for OP, we sample two images per occupation per occupation-gender and participant-gender combination (184 total). The remaining images form the respective validation sets. Because the original dataset is gender-balanced by design, both the training and validation sets remain balanced (OO) or near-balanced (OP) after splitting.
blocks.zh: 最初的Viso Gender[14]基准为23个职业提供了230个职业-目标说明和460个职业-参与者说明。 在690个原始说明中,有670个图像仍可访问。 我们通过按职业和性别分类的抽样将每个次级任务分开:对业务执行干事来说,我们为每个职业的每个被认为的性别抽样两个图像以供培训(共计92个);对业务执行干事来说,我们为每个职业的每个职业的性别和参与者-性别组合抽样两个图像(共计184个)。 其余的图像构成相应的验证集. 由于最初的数据集通过设计实现了性别平衡,所以培训和验证数据集在拆分后均保持平衡(OO)或接近平衡(OP).

blocks.en: 0.A.2 COCOBias
blocks.zh: 0.A.2 可可比亚斯

blocks.en: For the gender-annotated subset [ 62 ] of MSCOCO [ 10 ] , we first detect gender from the existing caption text: for each image, we scan all associated captions against predefined masculine and feminine word lists (see Tab. 5 ) and discard images whose captions contain conflicting gender signals or no gender words, so that a single gender can be inferred for each remaining sample. We then cross-reference with the MSCOCO instance annotations and the human-annotated gender labels from Zhao et al . [ 62 ] , keeping only single-person images (exactly one person bounding box) with a valid gender label ( i.e . , excluding Unsure , Both , or missing entries) that agrees with the caption-inferred gender. Finally, we reserve 20% of each gender group for training and use the remaining 80% for validation, down-sampling the majority gender in the validation set so that both groups are equally represented. Each image retains all of its original MSCOCO captions; at inference time, a caption containing gender words is selected for use as the in-context demonstration text.
blocks.zh: 对于MSCCO[10]的性别说明子集[62],我们首先从现有的标题文本中检测到性别:对于每个图像,我们对照预先定义的男性和女性词列表(见附件5)扫描所有相关的标题,并丢弃其标题含有冲突性别信号或没有性别词的图像,以便每个剩余样本可以推断出一个单一性别. 然后,我们与MSCO实例说明和赵等人的注解性别标签进行交叉参照。 [62] ,只保留与注解性别一致的单人图像(确切地说,一人的边框),并有有效的性别标签(即排除不确定、两者或缺失条目)。 最后,我们保留了每个性别小组的20%用于培训,并利用其余的80%用于鉴定,在鉴定中对大多数性别进行抽样,以便两个小组都有平等的代表。 每个图像保留其所有最初的 MSCOCO 标题;在推论时,会选择一个包含性别词的标题作为内文本演示文本使用.

blocks.en: 0.A.3 DCI
blocks.zh: 0.A.3 保卫儿童国际

blocks.en: The Densely Captioned Images (DCI) dataset [ 47 ] contains 7,805 images from SA-1B [ 26 ] . Each image is annotated with two image-level captions: a short caption that summarizes the scene in one sentence and an extra caption that describes additional layout and contextual details. We exploit these two captions to obtain reliable gender labels. We first exclude multi-person images by tokenizing the short and extra captions together and rejecting any image whose tokens overlap with a predefined set of plural and collective nouns (see Tab. 5 ). For the remaining images, we independently detect gender from the short caption and the extra caption using the same word lists as COCOBias and retain only images where the two captions agree on a single binary gender. We apply the same split procedure as COCOBias: 80% of each gender group is allocated to the validation set, 20% to the training set, and the validation set is balanced by down-sampling the majority gender.
blocks.zh: 感性说明图像(DCI)数据集[47]包含来自SA-1B的7,805个图像[26]. 每个图像都附加两个图像级别的标题:一个短标题以一句话概括场景,另一个附加标题描述额外的布局和背景细节. 我们利用这两个标题来获得可靠的性别标签。 我们首先排除多人图像,将短标题和附加标题一起表示,并拒绝任何其符号与预先定义的一组复数和集体名词重叠的图像(见Tab.5). 对于其余的图像,我们用与COCOBias相同的单词列表独立地从短标题和附加标题中检测性别,并且只保留两个标题就单一二进制性别达成一致的图像. 我们采用与COCOBias相同的分法程序:每个性别群体80%被分配到验证组,20%被分配到培训组,验证组通过对多数性别进行抽样来平衡。

blocks.en: 0.A.4 VisualCoT
blocks.zh: 0.A.4 视觉计算机

blocks.en: We derive our sets of samples used for VL-BICLE experiments from the GQA [ 23 ] subset of VisualCoT [ 44 ] by combining its training and validation splits and applying a multi-stage filtering pipeline. We first cross-reference each sample against the GQA scene graphs and retain only single-person images whose questions contain at least one gender word, removing who questions ( e.g . , Who is wearing a shirt? ) and samples whose text mentions multiple people. We then apply a neutralizability filter that keeps only samples whose gender words can all be replaced by a neutral equivalent ( e.g . , man → \to person , she → \to this person ), discarding those with words that resist neutralization ( e.g . , him , mother , policeman ). Finally, we deduplicate by keeping only the longest question per image to enforce a one-to-one mapping. The resulting set is split using the same procedure as COCOBias. For the validation split, we additionally pre-compute a gender-neutralized version of each question; at inference time, test queries use the neutralized question while in-context demonstrations retain their original gendered phrasing.
blocks.zh: 我们从GQA[23]子集VisualCoT[44]中提取了用于VL-BICLE实验的一组样本,其方法是结合其培训和验证分解,并采用多阶段过滤管道。 我们首先对照GQA场景图表对每个样本进行交叉参照,只保留问题至少包含一个性别单词的单人图像,去除谁的问题(如谁穿着衬衫?)和文本提到多人的样本. 然后,我们使用一个可中性过滤器,只保留其性别词语都可以被中性等同物(例如,男人 \\对人,她 \对这个人)所取代的样本,丢弃那些用语言抵抗中性的人(例如,他,母亲,警察). 最后,我们通过只保留每个图像最长的问题来强制进行一对一的绘图来简化. 所产生的一套产品采用与COCOBias相同的程序进行拆分。 对于验证拆分,我们还要预先计算每个问题的性别中性版本;在推论时,测试询问使用中性问题,而内文演示则保留其原来的性别措辞.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Word lists used for gender detection, evaluation, and multi-person filtering.

blocks.en: Tab. 5 lists the words used for gender detection, evaluation, and multi-person filtering across all datasets and evaluation pipelines. For gender detection and evaluation in image captioning, a generated caption is tokenized and matched against the masculine and feminine lists to determine its detected gender. If tokens from both lists co-occur, the output is counted as an error ( e i = 1 e_{i}=1 ). If only masculine (or only feminine) words appear, the corresponding gender is assigned. If no gendered words are found, or only neutral words appear, the output is treated as gender-neutral and is not counted as a gender error (but r i = 0 r_{i}=0 , since no explicit gender signal is revealed). The multi-person list is used during dataset construction ( e.g . , DCI) to exclude images depicting more than one person by matching caption tokens against plural and collective nouns.
blocks.zh: 标签5列出了用于性别检测、评价和对所有数据集和评价管道进行多人过滤的词。 关于图像字幕中的性别检测和评价,生成的字幕是象征性的,与男性和女性名单相匹配,以确定其检测到的性别。 如果两个列表中的符号为co-occur,则输出被算作一个错误(e i = 1 e _{i}=1). 如果只出现男性(或只出现女性)词语,则指定相应的性别。 如果找不到性别字,或者只出现中性字,则产出被视为性别中性,不计入性别错误(但r i = 0 r_{i}=0,因为没有显示明确的性别信号). 多人列表用于数据集构建(例如DCI),通过将标题符号与复数和集体名词匹配来排除描绘多人的图像.

blocks.en: For pronoun prediction using VisoGender, we follow the setting of the original paper where no text instruction is explicitly attached to the image. Each shot in the context shows an image with a complete possessive sentence such as The [occupation] and [pronoun] [object/participant] , where the pronoun is his or her according to the ground-truth gender. For the query image, we condition the model on the prefix The [occupation] and [next-token] and compare the next-token probabilities of his versus her to determine the predicted gender. An example prompt is shown below (here, [image q ] stands for the query image):

blocks.en: 0.C.3 VisualCoT

blocks.en: For VQA with CoT prompting, each shot in the context pairs an image with a question, to which the instruction Please think step by step, then answer the question. is appended. The response format for VisualCoT contains two fields: a multi-step reasoning chain (the chain-of-thought annotation from the original VisualCoT dataset) and the answer. To avoid explicit gender leakage in the query ( i.e . , an LVLM would not need to infer gender from the image and could instead directly copy it from the query question), we neutralize the query question before appending it to the context ( e.g . , man → \to person ); the questions in the ICL demonstrations retain their original gendered phrasing. For zero-shot evaluation ( k = 0 k{=}0 ), a non-human example is appended to the context to illustrate the output format.

blocks.en: Synthetic images introduced in Sec. 5 are generated from the captions of the COCOBias training set. For each training image, we select a caption that contains explicit gender words and use it as the generation prompt for the SDMs. Both models generate images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution.
